headline: Revenue accelerates while profit growth lags behind it
summary_short: NARI Technology's H1 2026 revenue was ¥27.77B, up 14.6% y/y, while net profit attributable to shareholders grew a slower 4.1% y/y to ¥3.07B; Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.29 was up sharply (+222.2%) q/q on the company's typical H2-weighted seasonality.
summary_long: H1 2026 revenue reached ¥27.77B, up 14.6% y/y from ¥24.24B. Net profit attributable to shareholders was ¥3.07B, up a more modest 4.1% y/y from ¥2.95B — revenue growth outpaced profit growth, implying margin compression, though the exact margin figure wasn't computable from the loaded table. Q2 standalone EPS of ¥0.29 was up 222.2% q/q from ¥0.09, consistent with NARI's characteristic back-half-loaded grid-equipment revenue recognition. The fetched profit-statement table carries no MD&A narrative, so no cause is stated for the margin gap.
confidence_notes: No edgarCik; shard sourceLink is a Yahoo fallback. Two WebSearch queries (one initially cross-matched to a similarly-named company, 国电南自/300938) failed to surface H1 2026 figures directly; the correct H1 2026 revenue/net-profit figures were obtained via WebFetch of Sina Finance's structured profit-statement table (non-aggregator financial-data page, sourced from the company's own filed financials). A separate WebFetch of futunn.com's earnings page initially appeared to show a much larger revenue figure (182.029亿元) which cross-checks as the Q2-standalone figure (H1 27.77B minus Q1's already-known 9.56B ≈ Q2's 18.20B), not H1 cumulative — flagging this discrepancy rather than using the futunn figure. No driver/MD&A text was located within budget (2 WebSearch + 3 fetches, one held in reserve), so no cause is stated for the revenue/profit growth gap. EPS row is the Q2-standalone actual from resolve-earnings-target.mjs's shard KPIs (Yahoo earningsChart) and is not on the same cumulative basis as the H1 revenue/profit rows.
